correctness.rationale: Affine hyperplane invariant measure dσ(u)dt weights normals by their projected simplex width. With Gaussian vector Z and centered isotropic G, expected successive gaps divided by expected full range give P(J=k)=E[Z_(k+1)−Z_(k)]/(2E max Z); Tonelli translates gaps to binomial·integral Φ^k(1−Φ)^(n−k). Each split k/(n−k) cuts exactly k(n−k) edges; barycentric positive-coordinate constraints give product-of-simplices section type. Symmetry telescopes end gaps to P(K≤k)=1+E Z_(k+1)/E max. Intermediate Gaussian order statistics at k=⌊n^x⌋ scale as −sqrt(2(1−x)log n), the maximum as sqrt(2 log n); L1 convergence via gaussian-maximum UI implies CDF 1−sqrt(1−x) of log V/log n−1. The full proof is appropriate; no need to infer asymptotics from verifier Monte Carlo. It matches the previously published exact Crofton formulas mathematically.
